flags.why: “Hãi” is not specifically Southern; [Vietnamese dictionaries](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-h%C3%A3i) record this fear sense without a regional restriction.

The entry omits the common family relationship meaning referring to one's child's spouse's parent, documented in [Vietnamese usage](https://tuoitre.vn/anh-sui-linh-quynh-xuong-ham-chi-sui-20171018175532695.htm).
flags.fix: Add noun [Southern]: parent of one's child's spouse; co-parent-in-law.

flags.why: Learners are more likely to encounter the [family relationship meaning](https://tuoitre.vn/phunuonline/tinh-sui-gia-a1482924.html) than the tree name.
flags.fix: Put the co-parent-in-law meaning first and the upas-tree meaning second.
